title: Regional Field CTO
Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

  • Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

  • Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

  • Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

  • Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

  • You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

  • Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

  • Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

  • Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

    Nice to have

  • Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

  • Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

  • Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

  • Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

  • Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

  • A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

title: Senior Associate Information Security Consultant
description:
YOUR JOB

Do you want to rethink information security consulting with AI? Are you excited to automate repetitive work, move faster and spend more time solving real customer challenges? Join us to combine your InfoSec expertise with AI, challenge inefficient ways of working and help shape how AI is used in security consulting.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • You own and develop customer relationships across the full lifecycle of our InfoSec-SaaS product, acting as a trusted advisor on information security.

  • You advise customers on complex security challenges and build pragmatic, scalable ISMS solutions using our platform.

  • You independently guide customers through audits and certifications such as ISO 27001 and TISAX®.

  • You use AI to automate repetitive consulting work, accelerate analysis and preparation, and free up more time for high-value customer interaction and problem-solving.

  • You experiment with new AI-powered ways of working and help shape how we use AI across InfoSec consulting, turning successful approaches into scalable best practices.

  • You support Sales and Customer Success in identifying and developing cross-selling and up-selling opportunities with existing customers.

  • You bring customer and technical insights back into the organisation, helping us continuously improve our InfoSec product, tooling and consulting approach.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools you need to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company.

  • A competitive salary, flexible working hours tailored to your needs, and benefits catering to health, family, and sustainability.

  • A secure and future-proof job with a professional working atmosphere and the dynamics of a maturing scale-up.

  • The opportunity to develop into a mentoring role, empowering and supporting up-and-coming talent.

  • The opportunity and budget to further develop your existing skills and build new ones, including in AI and information security.

  • Lots of responsibility and the opportunity to actively shape and define the future of Security & Compliance, including how we use AI to work smarter and deliver more value to our customers.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in information security, IT security, GRC, compliance or a closely related field.

  • You have hands-on experience with information security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX® or NIST and can confidently apply this knowledge in a customer context.

  • You are technically curious and genuinely excited about AI, automation and finding smarter ways to solve problems.

  • You already use AI tools in your work or are hungry to experiment, learn quickly and help shape how AI can improve information security consulting.

  • You enjoy working directly with customers, can challenge their thinking when needed and turn complex technical or regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic solutions.

  • You take ownership, work independently and look for ways to improve how things are done rather than simply following existing processes.

  • You have excellent German and English communication skills.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

title: Senior IoT Engineer (all genders) – Embedded Linux · Python · Yocto
description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior IoT Engineer (all genders), you join our Devices team and bridge both worlds: you own our Yocto-based Linux software platform and actively build the Python application services running on top of it. Python is your daily driver, but you go down to C/C++, drivers, and the kernel whenever hardware requires it. Neither pure BSP-only engineers nor high-level-only developers will be happy here - this is a true hybrid hands-on role.

Right now, we are building a new generalized Linux based platform for our next-generation hardware, harmonizing the software across all device types and making fleet health visible in real time. You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • Next-Gen OS Image: Design and build our new Yocto-based Linux image for the next hardware generation, and drive the migration of our fleet onto it.

  • Hardware Abstraction: Harmonize the software across scanners, payment terminals and screens into one maintainable codebase.

  • Fleet Updates: Design OS and application updates that never brick a device: A/B partitions, staged rollouts and clean versioning across hardware variants.

  • Fleet Observability: Build monitoring that shows the health of every device in real time, from memory leaks to network stability and hardware metrics.

  • Debugging: Find root causes across kernel, drivers, networking, memory and application code, on devices hundreds of kilometers away.

  • Technical Guidance: Bring senior judgment into architecture discussions with our IoT Platform, Backend and AI teams, document decisions and mentor engineers.

INSPIRE US BY

  • Embedded Linux Expertise: Hands-on experience building and maintaining embedded Linux products that are deployed in the field, ideally at fleet scale, and confidence working with Linux internals, GNU tools, and Bash

  • Background: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent practical experience

  • Yocto Experience: Proven experience building, customizing, and maintaining Linux images using Yocto

  • Python Development: Strong Python skills – Python will be your primary development language in this role

  • Systems Programming: Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as C++, Rust, Go, or Java

  • Operating System & Debugging: Solid understanding of Linux internals, bootloaders, systemd, drivers, kernel concepts, networking, and Docker, plus hands-on experience with debugging tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind, UART, and JTAG

  • Senior Mindset: You clarify requirements before designing a solution, consider the impact on other teams, and are comfortable making and defending technical decisions

  • Communication: You explain complex technical topics clearly and in a structured way, in fluent English (C1)

EXTRA POINTS FOR

  • Experience operating large-scale IoT fleets

  • Knowledge of industrial hardware, cameras, AI accelerators, modems, or network devices

  • Experience with computer vision, edge AI, or machine learning

  • Familiarity with MQTT and Protocol Buffers (ProtoBuf)

  • German language skills

What we offer

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

  • Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success

  • Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties

  • Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints.

  • Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs.

  • Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems.

  • Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads.

  • Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems

  • Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies

  • Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.

  • Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus.

  • Understanding of quasi optical propagation of millimeter waves; ray tracing and where it breaks down

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2-L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

(Senior) Account Executive SMB | DACH Market (m/w/d)

Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
Growth Engineer (Intern)
description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

 

During your Internship, you will:

Joining our Growth team involves:

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

description:

For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

As a Senior Data Scientist at Hims & Hers, you are a core driver of technical execution and innovation within our data organization. You take complex business challenges and translate them into robust, scalable data products and machine learning models. You will be trusted to operate with high autonomy, owning your projects from the initial exploratory analysis through to production deployment.

In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize our operations, refine our marketing efforts, and enhance the customer experience. You will not only build powerful models but also help uphold the engineering rigor and standards of our data team.

You Will:

  • Build from Scratch: Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment. You are comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write complex SQL, engineer your own features, and deploy baseline models (heuristics or simple ML) quickly to prove value before iterating toward complex solutions.

  • End-to-End Execution: Own the complete model lifecycle, from data extraction and feature engineering to deployment, A/B testing, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Finance teams to define technical requirements and translate model outputs into clear, actionable business insights.

  • Uphold Technical Standards: Write clean, modular, and production-ready code. Actively participate in peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical best practices.

  • Drive Project Delivery: Navigate technical ambiguity within your domain, breaking down complex project requirements into manageable, executable milestones.

  • Team Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and support to junior data scientists and analysts, helping them troubleshoot roadblocks and adopt best practices.

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years of applied experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, with a track record of delivering production-ready models that drive measurable business value.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Python and SQL. Deep familiarity with the Python data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and standard ML frameworks (such as PyTorch, XGBoost, or LightGBM).

  • Engineering Rigor: Proven ability to build for production. Experience working in cloud-based environments (AWS or GCP) and familiarity with CI/CD workflows, version control (Git), and ML Ops principles.

  • Analytical Problem Solving: Strong ability to connect technical metrics to business outcomes. You know how to choose the right algorithm for the right problem rather than just the most complex one.

  • Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical concepts, model limitations, and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Education: BS, MS, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, CS, Applied Math, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 0-to-1 Execution: Experience taking the very first machine learning models in an organization from exploratory notebooks to reliable, automated production pipelines.

  • Advanced Business ML (Experience in 1-2 of the following):

    • Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: Building predictive models for churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) to directly drive targeted marketing and product interventions.

    • Applied Forecasting: Time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or handling non-stationary data for demand or revenue planning.

The Opportunity

This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results.

Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role.

What You'll Own

Sales strategy and structure

  • Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised

  • Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel

  • Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve

  • Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity

  • Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them

  • Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it

Process, structure, and scalability

  • Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles

  • Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance

  • Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount

  • Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners

  • Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally

  • Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well

Global and remote team leadership

  • Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe

  • Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here

Exec partnership and GTM planning

  • Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs

  • Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction

  • Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales.   • Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter.

  • Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability.

  • People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate.

  • Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap.

  • Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built.   • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

Assistange au pilotage Projet : coordination entre l’intégrateur et les équipes Advancy ; coordoniation entre les équipes Advancy (Finance, RH) : suivi des points bloquants ; participation aux comités projet

title: Sales Development Representative – Alternance
description:
About Ibexa

We're a team of 350+ people across Europe and beyond who share one slightly stubborn belief: marketers deserve better tools. So we build them. Ibexa is the Agentic Marketing Platform, where AI agents take care of the repetitive work and marketers stay in charge of the ideas, the brand and the calls that matter.
Our products, Actito, Qualifio, Quable, Raptor and Cohesivo, each grew up as specialists in their own field. Today they work together as one platform, built by engineers, designers, consultants, product people and marketers who genuinely care about getting it right. We come from many countries and cultures, we speak plenty of languages (a few of them are code), and we're proud of our European roots: open, human and serious about trust. If you like big challenges, good company and a bit of fun along the way, you'll feel right at home.

Your Role

📍 Paris, France (Hybrid)

As a SDR (Alternant), you will help generate and qualify pipeline for Ibexa’s portfolio. You will work closely with Account Executives and partners to engage upper mid-market and enterprise prospects and secure qualified meetings.

This role is ideal for someone looking to build a strong foundation in B2B SaaS sales within a fast-growing European tech company.

What You’ll Do

  • Run outbound and inbound prospecting for a defined region or segment to deliver qualified meetings and Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)

What We Offer

title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD 
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais 

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys talking to customers, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and likes untangling problems that cut across multiple product areas. to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

    At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions.
     
    This is an exceptional opportunity for stellar sellers who want to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive measurable business impact — helping them realize the value of Aircall through trust, expertise, and long-term partnership.

title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
description:
👫  About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️  What you'll do

  • Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

  • Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

  • Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.

  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

  • Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪  About you

We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.

You will ideally have:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

  • A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

  • A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

  • Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

  • Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

  • Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.

  • A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands.

👊 Growth Expectations

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.

Within 6 months, you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.

Within 12 months, you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.

title: Lead Data Scientist H/F
description:
Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional cardiac electrophysiology.  

Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures.  

Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients.


Mission

As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide. 

Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory standards.


Your Responsibilities 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities.  

  • Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms.  

  • Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development.  

  • Stay up to date with the latest advances in AI and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into Volta's products.  

  • Support the definition of data strategies and contribute to the continuous improvement of data collection pipelines.  

Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and PhD researchers.  

  • Foster a collaborative, innovative and high-performance culture.  

  • Coach team members in both technical and professional development.  

  • Coordinate priorities, allocate resources and ensure timely project delivery.  

Product Development 

  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.  

  • Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components.  

  • Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code.  

  • Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions.  

Scientific & External Collaboration 

  • Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events.  

  • Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners.  

  • Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors. 


Your Profile

Education & Experience 

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field.  

  • 10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment.  

  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists.  

  • Experience working in regulated environments (Medical Devices, Healthcare, Automotive, Aerospace or similar) is a strong plus.  

  • Experience bringing AI models from research to production.  

Technical Skills 

  • Strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and statistical modeling.  

  • Excellent understanding of model development, evaluation and deployment.  

  • Strong programming skills in Python.  

  • Experience with PyTorch, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas and related ML libraries.  

  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, testing, CI/CD, Docker).  

  • Good knowledge of Linux environments.  

  • Experience with cloud computing and MLOps is a plus.  

  • Signal processing knowledge would be highly appreciated.  

Soft Skills 

  • Strong leadership and coaching abilities.  

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.  

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.  

  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.  

  • Fluent English (spoken and written). 


Why join Volta Medical? 

Artificial Intelligence is transforming healthcare, and Volta Medical is at the forefront of this revolution. 

Joining us means contributing to cutting-edge medical technologies that directly improve patients' lives while working alongside internationally recognized experts in electrophysiology, AI and medical devices. 

At Volta, you will enjoy: 

  • Meaningful work with real clinical impact.  

  • An international, multidisciplinary and collaborative environment.  

  • The opportunity to work on state-of-the-art AI applied to healthcare.  

  • High autonomy and opportunities for professional growth.  

  • Regular scientific exchanges and innovation-driven culture.  

  • A workplace located in Marseille, offering an exceptional Mediterranean lifestyle. 

Volta Medical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage qualified individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact on healthcare, we'd love to hear from you! 


Recruitment Process
  • Introductory & Culture Fit interview with our Senior VP People (45 min)
  • Technical & Leadership interview with our VP Innovation and our CTO (90min)
  • Interview with our CEO (60 min)
  • Coffee chat at our Marseille HQ (120 min) 
    Spend time with the Data Science team, our Chief Clinical & Regulatory Officer, and our Co-founders (Julien/Clément). Discover our working environment, exchange ideas, and get a feel for what it's like to build AI solutions at Volta Medical.

title: Solution Architect / Solution Engineer
description:
Une nouvelle vision de la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, des événements en direct, des loisirs et du sport.


Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, Fondation Louis Vuitton, Fondation du Patrimoine, Le Mans FC transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars, vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique.


vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles.


Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing.


En tant que Solution Architect, vos responsabilités comprendront:

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations sur mesure (connexions API, systèmes d’authentification SSO, ERP, etc.) en vous appuyant sur les puissants outils proposés par vivenu.

  • Accompagner nos grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs boutiques en ligne existantes vers une architecture moderne, entièrement pilotée par nos API.

  • Collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes techniques de nos clients — directeurs techniques, équipes informatiques, agences web externes, etc. — afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de définir des plans d’action clairs et concrets.

  • Veiller à ce que les attentes et les besoins des clients soient alignés avec les capacités de vivenu. Vous serez également le principal interlocuteur technique en interne pour traiter les problématiques complexes qui surviennent vente en période d’exploitation.
